description: Screen a person, company or vessel name against the Swiss consolidated sanctions list (SECO, all embargo programmes: Russia/Ukraine, Belarus, Iran, Syria, North Korea, ISIL/Al-Qaida, …). Matching is case- and diacritic-insensitive over primary names, aliases and Latin transliterations; all query words must match (as words or word prefixes). Returns current listings only unless include_delisted=true. A hit is a lead, not a legal determination: compare birth dates, nationality and documents via get_sanctions_entry. Example: {name: 'Rotenberg'}, {name: 'Aeroflot', type: 'entity'}.

include_delisted.description: Also return entries that have since been de-listed

name.description: Name or name fragment, e.g. 'Arkady Rotenberg', 'Sovcomflot'

program.description: Restrict to a sanctions programme, e.g. 'Ukraine', 'Iran', 'Syria' (see list_sanctions_programs)

type.description: Restrict to individuals, entities (companies/organisations) or objects (vessels, aircraft)

name: search_sanctions_list
title: Search the Swiss sanctions list
